instructions: Start with execute: return await flowbound.docs({ topic: "start" }). When running locally in a coding agent, pass the absolute path of the open project as the project argument. Workflows live in Git. From chat, save edits with workflow-save, check with workflow-change, and publish only when the person asks. Return a run, table or workflow directly from execute to open its view. To pick a view, return { flowboundView: { run: 123 } } (or use table, workflow or page). Set render: false for background reads. When execute says the result is in the chat app, summarize in one or two lines and leave the page link to its Open web page button. In a text-only chat, share the page link when execute returns one.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Find Flowbound tools
tools.description: Find Flowbound tools and read their inputs and prices. Leave query empty to list every tool. Search docs for the current guide, available without a shell. Flowbound runs GTM workflows (list building, research, enrichment) and keeps every paid fact, on the person's own data provider keys, under their permissions.

query.description: words to look for, like: run, table, import, lookup, firecrawl

project.description: Absolute path to the open project folder. Include it when using local Flowbound from a coding agent.

tools.name: execute
tools.title: Run code against Flowbound
tools.description: Run JavaScript that calls Flowbound tools and returns what you need. Each tool is an async function: `return await flowbound.runs({ state: "running" })`, `await flowbound["schedule-run"]({ name })`. Call several with Promise.all, filter big answers before returning them, console.log to see steps. It reaches only the tools, as you, with your rights: no files, no network, no keys. Return a run, table or workflow directly to display it. Omit code to open Flowbound. Find tools and their inputs with search first.

code.description: the body of an async function; return the answer. Omit to open Flowbound.

project.description: Absolute path to the open project folder. Include it when using local Flowbound from a coding agent.

render.description: Set false for background calls that should have no app content.
